meta.name: 2x2 piston door
meta.description: Four sticky pistons close a 2x2 doorway. Two torches keep the door shut; the lever turns them off and the door opens. Bedrock has no quasi-connectivity, so each upper piston is powered through the block its torch strongly powers. The design shows the pistons retracted; the torches extend them on placement (with /function), closing the door. Because it moves at rest, run rsd/2x2-piston-door_clear before building it again in the same place.

annotations.text: Torch powers the lower piston beside it and strongly powers the stone above, which powers the upper piston.
Lever on: the dust powers the stones the torches hang on, the torches go out and the door opens.
